verdict.rationale: Bevy documents an official community assets page listing third-party assets, plugins, and learning resources, showing an ecosystem exists (bevy-docs-17), and community comments confirm a lively contributor base (bevy-comm-19). However, there's no evidence of the scale, curation, or maturity of this ecosystem compared to established asset stores, and one commenter notes the desire for more built-in tooling like an editor (bevy-comm-6). Missing for 10: evidence of ecosystem size/quality, curated marketplace features, and independent confirmation that third-party plugins/models are abundant or production-ready.
